steps.name: Environment & Workspace Audit
steps.command: node -v && npm -v && test -d backend && test -d frontend && test -d ai-service && echo Monorepo workspace structure verified

parallel.name: Backend Service Audit
parallel.command: cd backend && cat package.json && test -f tsconfig.json && echo Backend TypeScript configuration verified

parallel.name: Frontend Client Audit
parallel.command: cd frontend && cat package.json && test -f vite.config.ts && echo Frontend Vite and React configuration verified

parallel.name: AI Service Syntax Compilation
parallel.command: cd ai-service && python3 -m py_compile main.py && echo FastAPI AI Resume processing engine compiled and verified

steps.name: Deployment & Compose Readiness
steps.command: test -f docker-compose.yml && test -f nginx.conf && echo Docker Compose and Reverse Proxy configuration verified && echo Pipeline PASSED - All service checks passed successfully
